{{Quote|I cross-checked the coordinates--it's a warehouse on Mek-Sha. Typical.|[[Mendi Dian]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A '''hideout''' was established by [[Umbral]] at [[Slugfall Harbor]] within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] discovered the hideout to put an end to Umbral's actions and uncover the secrets of the [[Master's Top Secret Army]].<ref name="TOR" />
